name: Varric Ashenleaf
source_profile: ● Varric Ashenleaf (LN) is the commander of the Mountain Wardens. Fiercely loyal to Torven, but increasingly concerned that the elder is committing the tribe to a war it cannot sustain.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 67 (source excerpt; may be partial)
